## 9. Camping Quai — simple, family-run and directly lakeside

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 73, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://campingquai.it/>  
**2026 season:** 24 April–11 October

Quai is a separate, family-run lakeside campsite with transparent pricing. For **2 September**, its MID-season rates are **€33 lakefront, €29 second row, €26 XL, €23 central and €20 fourth row**, plus **€12 per adult**, €1 tourist tax per adult and roughly €2–3/day for electricity. The higher July–August MAX rates are €36 / €32 / €29 / €26 / €22 respectively.

Recent camper reviews praise the friendliness, sanitary facilities, restaurant and proximity to Iseo. One useful caveat is that several reviewers describe the actual beach area as limited; the lakefront pitches get the best water views.

Crucially for this trip, Quai **does have its own SUP/kayak rental**. The current official tariff is **€10 for 1 hour, €18 for 2 hours, €25 for 3 hours, €32 for 4 hours or €37 for a full day** for a SUP/single kayak. The campsite recommends reserving the equipment **at least one day in advance at reception**.


**2 September booking note:** Exact availability requires a direct request. Advance bookings normally require three nights (four for lakefront); for shorter stays the campsite explicitly recommends calling the day before to ask about gaps. See the consolidated price table above.

**Booking / price list:** <https://campingquai.it/en/price-list/> · info@campingquai.it · +39 030 9821610

**Best for:** simple lakeside camping near town, people who like small family-run sites, and travellers who want **on-site SUP rental with published prices and advance-reservation guidance**.  
**Downside:** limited beach compared with Camping Iseo/Punta d’Oro; published SUP fleet size is unknown.

---

## 10. Camping del Sole Village — best full-service resort

**Location:** Via per Rovato 26, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.campingdelsole.it/en/>  
**2026 season:** 2 April–11 October  
**Scale:** about 90,000 m²

Del Sole is the most resort-like option: pools, restaurants, market, entertainment, sports facilities and a beach, while still being only around a 10-minute walk from Iseo centre. Its current official site explicitly confirms **SUP, canoe, pedal-boat and boat rental** directly from the campsite. The number of SUPs is **not published**, so the guide does not assume the large fleet size claimed in some secondary commentary; contact the rental operation ahead if two boards at the same time are essential.

For camper vans, the key distinction is pitch type. Standard/lake-zone pitches are aimed at vehicles up to roughly **7 m**, while some larger pitches can take campers around **7–9 m** and reach about 12 × 7 m. More fully equipped pitches can add direct water, while facilities vary by pitch category; do not assume every pitch has a full water/drainage hookup.

There are pet-friendly zones, but the **lake-zone pitches are listed as no-dog**, so check the exact category when booking.


**2 September booking note:** The booking engine is active, but its public pages do not expose reliable date-specific inventory. By 2 September, del Sole is already in its cheaper mid-season tariff. See the consolidated availability/price table above.

**Live booking engine:** <https://booking.slope.it/a82e8019-8f76-4920-bcd1-9825337ed1e2>

**Best for:** families, people who want everything on site, SUP renters, larger camper vans that can book a suitable large pitch.  
**Downside:** much less intimate than Covelo/Punta d’Oro; lake-zone pitch choices are more constrained for dogs and larger vehicles.

---

## 11. Camping Eden — strong north-lake option in Pisogne

**Location:** Via Piangrande 3/A, Pisogne  
**Official website:** <https://campingedenpisogne.com/>  
**2026 season:** 1 April–30 September

Camping Eden is directly on the northern end of Lake Iseo, at the foot of Valle Camonica. Italia.it describes a **15,000 m²** campsite with differently sized pitches, about **200 m from the railway station, 300 m from Pisogne's central square and 400 m from a large shopping centre**. Camping.info currently lists **99 total pitches**, while PiNCAMP confirms 2–6A hook-ups and a full motorhome service setup for wastewater, cassette toilet and fresh-water needs.

The SUP setup is particularly strong for travellers without their own boards. **Surface SUP Academy** operates a second base at **X Beach, Via Piangrande, Pisogne**, in addition to its Marone base, and its 2026 rental page offers All-Round, Superior and Race boards. All-Round pricing is **€12.50/1h, €22/2h, €33/3h, €40/4h or €65/day**, plus the €3.50 2026 Guest membership. That puts a dedicated SUP operator on the same lakeside Via Piangrande strip as the campsite.

Current camper reviews are quite consistent about the trade-off: the location, lake access, staff and walkability into Pisogne are praised, but several 2026 reviews say **pitches can be relatively small and the sanitary facilities are old/due for renovation**, although generally clean. For a medium rental camper this is still a credible fit; request a pitch that comfortably takes your exact dimensions.

**2 September booking note:** exact live inventory was not publicly exposed in the sources checked. Current 2026 comparison pricing is roughly **€46–49/night for a couple in high season**, but obtain an exact quote including electricity/tax for your camper.

**Best for:** a northern-lake base, dedicated SUP rental nearby, walking into a real town, train access, full camper-service capability.  
**Downside:** older/smaller sanitary infrastructure and some modest pitch sizes; less polished than the resort sites.
